name: Guangxi LiuYao Group Co., Ltd
summary: Guangxi LiuYao Group Co., Ltd engages in the manufacturing, wholesale, and retail of pharmaceutical products in China. It offers various types of medicines, medical devices, consumables, diagnostic reagents, other innovative drugs, and self-produced products through online pharmacies and terminal physical pharmacies. The company also offers health consultations and engages in food manufacturing. Guangxi LiuYao Group Co., Ltd was founded in 1981 and is based in Liuzhou, China.
